items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I remember he was from St. Louis, you know.

ctx.x: No. Right. And we had so many guys that were... I'll tell you another guy that used to be an announcer, the baseball announcer, the Yankee guy... I remember he was from St. Louis, you know.
But we're not into the sports now. We're into the music thing.
